raw_reward_bound: 64*duration; raw reward retained separately for audit, not an actor input
history: Canonical Node encoder owns exact within-epoch history. A changed epoch cannot include a present frame at/before the original starting observation; post-boundary frames may legitimately accumulate during multi-step waits. No epoch inferred from motor commands.
replay: 8192bounded entries; canonical states plus original observation/encoding clocks, record sequences, epochs, duration, float64discount/raw reward and natural terminal reason. State/model tensors float32.
optimizer_and_rng: Unchanged base architecture/Adam/loss/gradient clip/target cadence/private Python+Torch RNG recipe. New learner and checkpoint identity; old one-step checkpoints are incompatible.
resume: Same CPU runtime, between episodes only; variable-duration replay, online/target/Adam/private RNG/counters and cursor. Safe inherited weights_only loader. No mid-episode plant/RNG claim.
passive_prefix: No action exists before the first request. Never fabricate a replay action for this prefix; preserve its steps/reward and final outcomes in the episode journal.
